data.title: Liv Waterside
data.about:
Discover the elegance of waterfront living at Liv Residences Waterside, nestled in a private, gated enclave along the scenic Marina Promenade These elite residences redefine the essence of luxury living beside the water, offering a selection of premium homes, each with stunning views of Dubai Marina and the sea.

Liv Residences Waterside is a beacon of contemporary lifestyle, presenting a range of 1-3 bedroom apartments, each crafted with a European flair. The residences feature expansive balconies to soak in the tranquil beauty of the Marina, and the high 2.9m ceilings add a majestic feel to each living space. The charm of Liv Waterside at Dubai Marina extends to its exclusive array of housing options, including duplex penthouses, 3-bedroom duplexes, townhouses, opulent villas, and a grand mansion, all designed to the highest standards of elegance and luxury.

Inhabitants of Liv Waterside enjoy exclusive access to three levels of superior serviced amenities, ensuring a lavish lifestyle experience. These facilities, coupled with a dedicated Wellness Manager, are meticulously arranged to enhance community well-being and luxury living standards under the banner of Liv Developers.

characteristics_module.title: Liv On The Waters Edge
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Spectacular Marina Views: Situated in Dubai Marina, offering stunning waterfront and marina views.
  • Exclusive Gated Community: Luxurious entrance, 24-hour security, in a tranquil, green setting.
  • Eco-Friendly Living: Electric Vehicle Charging Stations and a dedicated amenities elevator.
  • Wi-Fi Enabled Amenities: Complimentary Wi-Fi across all residential amenity areas.
  • Security and Service: 24/7 reception, security, and concierge.
  • Premium Amenities: Three levels of state-of-the-art amenities for residents.

location_tile.title: Your private resort in the heart of Dubai Marina
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located along Dubai's shoreline, Dubai Marina is an iconic neighborhood known for its urban elegance and scenic views. The area centers around a three-kilometer canal, lined with skyscrapers and waterside homes. It offers upscale amenities, a vibrant Marina Walk, and the Dubai Marina Yacht Club, providing easy Arabian Gulf access and waterfront activities.

Areas Nearby:

  • Atlantis 0.55km
  • Dubai Marina Mall 0.7km
  • JBR Beach 1.2km
  • Blossom Marina Nursery Dubai 1.6km
  • Downtown Dubai 22.1km
  • Dubai International Airport 34.6km
